paragraphs: I'm a Data Scientist working across Python, SQL, and machine learning — from exploratory analysis and feature engineering to forecasting and production APIs.
At Samatrix, I apply NLP and LLM techniques to unstructured text for classification and information extraction, and prototype RAG workflows with embeddings and vector search.
My work has improved decision-making by 15%, achieved 99.9% preprocessing accuracy, and resolved 95% of identified data discrepancies.

projects.description: Real-world applications of data science, ML, and engineering.

items.title: Sales Forecasting System
items.description:
Engineered an end-to-end forecasting pipeline using the Rossmann retail dataset and evaluated 3 models: SARIMA, LightGBM, and LSTM.

Deployed forecasts through an interactive FastAPI web application.

items.title: Sentiment Analysis Studio
items.description:
Implemented a FastAPI application running Logistic Regression, SVM, and Naive Bayes models for single-text and batch classification.

Integrated confidence scores, confusion matrices, and CSV export to support model review and results analysis.

items.title: Sales Analysis Dashboard
items.description:
Designed a 12-month Power BI dashboard suite with 5+ interactive reports covering profit margins across 50 zones and 15+ product subcategories.

Identified low-margin zones and subcategories to support pricing and profitability decisions.

mlPipeline.description: The lifecycle I follow on every data science and ML project, from raw data to something a team can rely on.

stages.title: Data Collection
stages.text: Pulling from SQL databases, APIs, and raw files — understanding what the data actually represents before touching it.

stages.title: Data Cleaning
stages.text: Standardized preprocessing with Python and Pandas — handling nulls, duplicates, and inconsistencies.

stages.title: EDA
stages.text: Exploratory analysis to find patterns, outliers, and relationships before choosing an approach.

stages.title: Feature Engineering
stages.text: Shaping raw fields into signals a model can actually learn from.

stages.title: Model Training
stages.text: Scikit-learn and TensorFlow for classification, regression, and clustering tasks, iterated against a validation set.

stages.title: Evaluation
stages.text: Checking accuracy against the metric that actually matters for the business question — not just the easiest one to report.

stages.title: Deployment
stages.text: Shipping via dashboards (Power BI/Tableau) or lightweight apps so non-technical stakeholders can use the output directly.

stages.title: Monitoring
stages.text: Auditing data quality on an ongoing basis — in my current role this catches ~95% of data discrepancies before they become decisions.
